Carl Allen was born on April 25, 1961 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and is a powerful role model for the twenty-first century young jazz musician. He has found success and fulfillment as an educator with the Juilliard School; as a producer with his own company, Big Apple Productions; and as a performer with over 200 recordings to his credit. In 2012 he received an honorary degree in Humane Letters from Snow College. Carl created The Art of Elvin tribute band dedicated to Art Blakey and Elvin Jones, and currently leads The Carl Allen Quartet.
Carl was interviewed in Atlanta, GA, on January 4, 2013, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
